records.title: Red River (Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori) — Episode 18 "Proof of Innocence" (Gyuzel)
records.meta: TV anime · Japan · Japanese · Nippon TV AnichU / Tatsunoko Production · ep 18 aired 3 Nov 2026 (late night, JST 4 Nov 1:40) · streaming on FOD and other Japanese services
records.summary: Gyuzel, a noblewoman, has been claiming her young son is Crown Prince Kail's. In episode 18 Kail shows the Senate that Gyuzel and Prince Juda were being controlled by Queen Mother Nakia through a 'black water' drink. Kail squeezes the black water out of Gyuzel with a bear hug. Freed, she confesses that the child's father is a travelling scholar, not Kail, and Nakia's plot is exposed.

episodes.gist: Black-water control of Gyuzel exposed and broken; she confesses the child is not Kail's

records.pregnancy_note: Not stated in sources (her son was already born about a year earlier).
records.kids_note: Before this arc she had a young son. Per the episode 16 and 18 recaps his father is a travelling scholar, not Kail. Sources do not say whether she ends up with any partner or has more children.
